model.name: A1 Generic Risk Management Model
model.description: Generic SABSA A1 model for turning business context, attributes, risks, appetite, objectives, architecture design, implementation, monitoring, and feedback into a traceable ArchiMate structure.

generic_objects.name: Business Context
generic_objects.description: Stakeholders, business drivers, goals, constraints, regulatory obligations, and operating context.

generic_objects.name: Business Attributes
generic_objects.description: Measurable business-driven attributes used to express enablement and control needs.

generic_objects.name: Risk Appetite and Thresholds
generic_objects.description: Decision boundaries for acceptable risk, performance thresholds, and escalation criteria.

generic_objects.name: Risk View
generic_objects.description: Prioritised risk scenarios, causes, impacts, current exposure, and treatment options.

generic_objects.name: Enablement and Control Objectives
generic_objects.description: Business-aligned objectives that drive policy, design, services, mechanisms, and assurance.

generic_objects.name: Risk Treatment Solution Architecture
generic_objects.description: Conceptual, logical, physical, and component treatment design for controls and enablers.

generic_objects.name: Performance Evidence
generic_objects.description: KPIs, KRIs, scorecards, dashboards, assurance results, incidents, audit findings, and improvement evidence.

generic_objects.name: Vitality Backlog
generic_objects.description: Continuous improvement and architecture change backlog triggered by metrics, assurance, incidents, and new business requirements.

phases.name: Strategy and Planning
phases.description: Establish the business and risk context, derive the risk view, and set risk management strategy and objectives.
activities: Establish stakeholders, business drivers, business attributes, and risk appetite
Identify, assess, and evaluate risks against business targets
Define enablement objectives, control objectives, and conceptual design direction

phases.name: Design
phases.description: Translate risk objectives into conceptual, logical, physical, and component-level treatment architecture.
activities: Perform gap analysis of controls and enablers
Define policies, services, procedures, mechanisms, tools, and operational components
Maintain traceability from objectives to treatment design

phases.name: Implement
phases.description: Plan, prove, roll out, train, test, and validate the selected risk treatment solution.
activities: Plan proof of concept and rollout
Test through audit, system tests, process tests, penetration tests, UAT, and OAT

phases.name: Manage and Measure
phases.description: Operate, monitor, assure, and report risk and security performance through metrics, scorecards, and dashboards.
activities: Run assurance, audit, live penetration testing, and review activities
Monitor KPIs, KRIs, risk scorecards, dashboards, and maturity improvement

phases.name: Govern and Communicate
phases.description: Keep risk decisions, accountability, reporting, communication, and policy direction aligned across the lifecycle.
activities: Set decision rights and risk ownership
Communicate appetite, policy, performance, and residual risk
Escalate decisions where thresholds or accountability boundaries are crossed

phases.name: Assure
phases.description: Provide through-life assurance that the architecture and its operation remain fit for purpose, traceable, compliant, and effective.
activities: Check completeness, assurance, compliance, performance, justification, and significance
Validate traceability from business attributes to controls, metrics, and evidence
Feed assurance findings into vitality and architecture change management

nibocj.name: NIST
nibocj.description: Risk, controls, cybersecurity outcomes, continuous monitoring, and assessment references.

nibocj.name: ISO
nibocj.description: ISMS requirements, risk management process, controls, and measurement references.

nibocj.name: BSI
nibocj.description: German IT-Grundschutz orientation for baseline protection, safeguards, checks, and risk analysis.

nibocj.name: OCTAVE
nibocj.description: Asset-driven operational risk analysis, scenario thinking, and organisational risk workshops.

nibocj.name: COBIT
nibocj.description: Governance and management objectives for enterprise information and technology.

nibocj.name: jArchi
nibocj.description: Automation layer for ArchiMate model generation, traceability properties, folder placement, and view rendering.
